name: Arad Ltd.
summary: Arad Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, plans, develops, manufactures, and sells water measurement and management products and solutions in Israel, Latin America, Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers water metering solutions, including smart measurement, smart data solutions, smart data analytics, and communication protocols/IoT, as well as automated meter reading/advanced metering infrastructure products, such as drive by/walk by reading system, fixed network, city mind meter data management system, and dialog 3G cellular. It also provides residential water meters; bulk water meters; agriculture solutions, comprising water meters, hydrometers, fertilizers …
